outcome: Healthcare costs (to government, private insurers, and individuals)
cohort: The study included all women with births in the state of Queensland, Australia between 01 July 2012 and 30 June 2015 (n = 189,081).
finding: Total healthcare costs from birth to 12 months post-birth were 636% higher for women with postnatal MDD compared to those without, and among women with postnatal MDD, there were significant socioeconomic inequalities in the types of services accessed and costs to different funders.
